description: This file defines the Credentials interface for connection credentials, including methods for serialization, deserialization, and extensibility via subclasses. It also includes a nested class for managing JSON field definitions and deserializer registration.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: Interface representing connection credentials with methods for JSON serialization, deserialization, and visitor pattern acceptance.

classes.name: Credentials.JsonFields
classes.description: Nested static class holding JSON field definitions and deserializer registry for Credentials subclasses.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to evaluate the Credentials object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Credentials object to JSON.

methods.name: registerDeserializer
methods.description: Registers a deserializer function for a specific credential type.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Credentials object from JSON, using registered deserializers.
